# Filmlog

> Filmlog is a self hosted film diary and watchlist for one person. It records every viewing with date, rating (1 to 10), companions and a note, shows a status for every film (seen, on the watchlist, never seen) and suggests three unseen films for tonight. It integrates TMDB, Plex and Trakt and runs as a Laravel 13 app in Docker with PostgreSQL. The interface is German.

## Key facts

- Current version: 0.1.0 (see https://github.com/roberteinsle/filmlog/releases)
- Purpose: answer "have I seen this already?" and "what do we watch tonight?"
- Users: exactly one account per installation (set by FILMLOG_ADMIN_EMAIL); companions are tracked per viewing
- Film data: TMDB (free API token required), German language and region by default
- Plex: webhook turns finished films (about 90 % watched) into diary entries; nightly library sync marks films on the server; selectable Plex Home profiles
- Trakt: one time ZIP import of history, ratings, watchlist and lists; repeatable without duplicates
- Tonight: suggestions from the watchlist or the Plex library, filtered by companions' age limit, time, mood and streaming subscription
- Review: hours watched, top genres, favourite directors, disagreements with TMDB, unfinished film series
- Cinema charts: German yearly box office charts since 1970 (source InsideKino)
- Login: passkey, one time login link, optional authenticator codes; no passwords
- Stack: PHP 8.5, Laravel 13, Livewire 4, Tailwind CSS 4, PostgreSQL 17, one Docker image for app, queue worker and scheduler; GitHub Actions, GHCR, Coolify
- Privacy: self hosted, no analytics, no external account; history stays in the user's own database
